label: A three-path comparison for checking difficulty, value, or both before choosing a response.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 530"><rect x="8" y="8" width="464" height="514" rx="18" fill="#f4f1e9" stroke="#626865" stroke-width="3"/><text x="30" y="45" font-size="22">When willingness to continue falls</text><text x="30" y="75" font-size="17">Compare before and now; keep other causes in view.</text><rect x="24" y="96" width="432" height="96" rx="14" fill="#fff" stroke="#626865" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="130" font-size="21">Difficulty rose</text><text x="46" y="158" font-size="17">Check the new cost;</text><text x="46" y="180" font-size="17">change the arrangement.</text><rect x="24" y="204" width="432" height="96" rx="14" fill="#fff" stroke="#626865" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="238" font-size="21">Value faded</text><text x="46" y="266" font-size="17">Check actual effects;</text><text x="46" y="288" font-size="17">clarify or reconsider.</text><rect x="24" y="312" width="432" height="96" rx="14" fill="#fff" stroke="#626865" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="346" font-size="21">Both may shift</text><text x="46" y="374" font-size="17">Check each change</text><text x="46" y="396" font-size="17">on its own.</text><rect x="24" y="424" width="432" height="48" rx="14" fill="#e4eee7" stroke="#405b4b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="240" y="454" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">Choose: continue, alter, pause, or stop</text><text x="30" y="502" font-size="16">Unclear cause? Gather evidence before choosing.</text></svg>
